subject: SLA uplift request + reserved pool expansion — tokens/sec annex
messages:
From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@scalegrid.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal Q: reserved pool uplift and tokens/sec guarantee

Hi Priyom,

We're starting renewal planning for Sept 1 and want to lock in a committed uplift to our Dedicated reserved pool. A few specifics from our side: 

- Target reserved GPUs: +6 A100-equivalent (scale from current 8 -> 14)
- Steady-state throughput target: 18k tokens/sec (across pool) with 5s p95 latency on chat workloads
- Burst window: allow up to 26k tokens/sec for short windows (up to 120s) during peak batch jobs
- Fallback behavior: in the event of sustained capacity pressure we need deterministic fallback to a compatible model variant (lower-cost quantized) rather than request rejection

Can Redwood provide SLO language for tokens/sec (aggregate + per-route), the burst credits model, and a handback playbook we can include in the contract? Also please include pricing delta for the additional GPUs and proposed term change (12 -> 24 months) if we commit to the uplift.

Budget owner is Ops — copying Marissa and Rishi so we can align on commercials.

Thanks,
Dana

--
Dana Liu
Head of Platform Engineering, ScaleGrid
Dana mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@scalegrid.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal Q: reserved pool uplift and tokens/sec guarantee

Hi Dana — thanks for the clear ask. High level response and next steps below. Draft SLO annex attached for your review (ScaleGrid_SLO_Renewal_Draft_v1.pdf).

Summary proposal (high level):
- Reserved capacity: +6 A100-equivalent GPUs added to your existing dedicated pool, effective at renewal.
- Aggregate tokens/sec SLO: 18,000 tokens/sec sustained (30m rolling average) with p95 <= 5s for the prioritized chat route.
- Burst credit model: 100% of steady-state for short bursts up to 120s, capped at 26,000 tokens/sec. Burst consumption is tracked per billing period; excess usage billed at overage rate unless you purchase burst credits up-front.
- Deterministic fallback: We will automatically route to a validated 4-bit quantized variant when pool saturation >= 85% for >45s; fallback decision is logged and surfaced in Console with correlated request IDs.
- Canary & rollout: 72-hour canary for any model variant switch; emergency rollback within 10 minutes on quality regressions.
- Term & pricing: If you commit to 24 months, incremental monthly fee for +6 GPUs is $28,000/mo (includes higher-priority preemption protection and extended support). 12-month pricing is $34,000/mo. Full pricing sheet attached.

Notes / open items:
- Need to align on the exact routes/endpoints that count toward the 18k tokens/sec SLO (we recommend marking two highest-volume chat routes).
- We propose a quarterly runbook review and an on-call escalation path for incidents affecting SLO.

Ask from you: please confirm the routes and whether you prefer pre-purchased burst credits or overage billing; we can update the annex accordingly.

I'll loop Legal once you greenlight the language so they can fold it into the renewal amendment.

Best,
Priyom

--
Priyom Das
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
Attachments: ScaleGrid_SLO_Renewal_Draft_v1.pdf (application/pdf), RG-3209_proposed_pricing_sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal Q: reserved pool uplift and tokens/sec guarantee

Marissa / Aisha — forwarding the request + my draft annex. Quick internal ask:

- Can Legal and Commercial sign off on the deterministic fallback paragraph (we've included automatic quantized failover at >=85% saturation)? Any concerns about SLA credit exposure?
- Pricing sensitivity: they prefer 24 months but want to know if we can offer a 3-month ramp (pay for 3 GPUs month 1, +3 GPUs month 2, full +6 month 3) without changing the SLO measurement window.
- Approve burst credits model vs overage: ScaleGrid's ops prefers pre-purchased credits for predictability.

Suggested internal reply so I can respond quickly to Dana: approve fallback language with a caveat that any production-quality regressions discovered during fallback trigger immediate rollback and root-cause timeline (we'll limit credit exposure by capping penalty at X% — please advise). Also propose we offer the 3-month ramp with pro-rated pricing and the same SLO measured once full pool is live.

Thanks — need a quick thumbs so we can lock dates before Aug 8.

Priyom

--
(The forwarded draft is the same ScaleGrid_SLO_Renewal_Draft_v1.pdf and pricing sheet)

From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@scalegrid.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal Q: reserved pool uplift and tokens/sec guarantee

Priyom — thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft. We reviewed with Ops and Procurement. A few items before we sign: 

1) Confirm the quantized fallback variants have been validated on our top-2 routes with no >3% quality regressions (we'll run an eval but need your validation summary).
2) Ramp: the 3-month ramp works for us — please provide pro-rated invoice schedule.
3) Burst credits: we'll purchase a 2-month upfront burst credit package to start and re-evaluate next quarter.

If those three items are in the final annex we'll route for internal approval today. Once legal signs off we'll need a DocuSign link.

Please send the updated annex with the validation summary and the DocuSign stub.

Best,
Dana

--
Dana Liu
Head of Platform Engineering, ScaleGrid
Attachments referenced: none (ScaleGrid will sign once we supply the updated draft + docusign)
